newsitem.title: USA: Asarco reconsiders Black Cloud shutdown.
newsitem.headline: Asarco reconsiders Black Cloud shutdown.

text.p: Asarco Inc said it has reconsidered its recent decision to shut down its Black Cloud mine in Leadville, Colo., and has decided to resume mine operations early in 1997.
Recall of mine workers will begin early in January with the restart of operations to be phased in during January with resumption of fully employment at the mine by February 1.
Full production is expected to be resumed at the mine by mid-March, Asarco said.
In 1995, the mine produced 15,400 short tons of zinc, 5,000 tons of lead and 340,000 ounces of silver.
